metadata.method: Compare pre-tournament travel/climate risk flags + group posture vs actual knockout outcomes for 8 priority D+L teams
metadata.scope: Priority 8 only. Not a full 48-team model grade.

United States.thesis: Host + Group D favorite; low-rest flag noted but indoor venues mitigate climate.
United States.reality: Won group, beat Bosnia in R32, collapsed 1-4 vs Belgium in R16. Host edge died early.
United States.lesson: Pre-match structural flag had directional value.

Paraguay.thesis: Third in D on tiebreak; travel OK; upset potential vs bigger names.
Paraguay.reality: Knocked out Germany on pens (R32), lost 0-1 to France (R16). Overperformed group seed.
Paraguay.lesson: Pre-match structural flag had directional value.

Australia.thesis: High travel km + Miami climate stress (score 14) + low rest = fatigue risk.
Australia.reality: 2nd in group then exited R32 on pens to Egypt. Climate/travel flag aligned with early KO.
Australia.lesson: Pre-match structural flag had directional value.

Türkiye.thesis: Low rest + bottom-group risk; thin margin in D.
Türkiye.reality: Finished 4th, group exit. Risk flags matched floor outcome.
Türkiye.lesson: Pre-match structural flag had directional value.

England.thesis: Group L favorite but climate stress vs Croatia (14) and low rest flagged.
England.reality: Won group, reached SF, lost to Argentina, took 3rd with 6-4 vs France. Climate flag did not cap them.
England.lesson: Structural flag did not bind; talent/tactics dominated.

Croatia.thesis: Low rest in L; historically deep KO runs.
Croatia.reality: 2nd in group, exited R32 1-2 to Portugal. Rest flag minor; quality gap bigger.
Croatia.lesson: Partial alignment only; do not overweight single flag.

Ghana.thesis: Best-third path possible; low rest flagged; climate neutral vs home baseline.
Ghana.reality: 3rd in L, advanced as best-third, lost 0-1 to Colombia in R32.
Ghana.lesson: Partial alignment only; do not overweight single flag.

Panama.thesis: No major travel red flags but weakest L side on paper.
Panama.reality: 0 pts, group exit. Floor outcome, little signal value beyond market.
Panama.lesson: No useful edge signal beyond obvious strength gap.

summary.headline: Priority desk grade: 4 HIT / 1 MISS / 2 MIXED / 1 N/A. Travel and climate flags were useful as early-exit risk markers (Australia, Türkiye, USA R16 collapse context) but failed as a ceiling cap on England, who took 3rd despite the highest climate scores on the desk. Paraguay’s Germany upset was the cleanest “third-place path” win; host premium on USA was the cleanest miss on narrative, not on rest flags.
keep: Rest-day gaps under 3 between group matches as a fatigue marker
High climate_score (≥10) as an early-KO risk, not a deep-run veto
Third-place path teams with low travel load (Paraguay) as upset candidates
Source-linked results archive over live odds chrome
drop: Treating climate stress as a hard ceiling on elite squads
Host-nation narrative premium without defensive quality checks
Expanding all-48 squad depth after the final whistle
Live edge / paper ledger features on a completed tournament
